payout_quote: Limited-time New Customer Offer: earn a $100 bonus on the All Access Checking account when you are new to Valley personal checking and receive at least $500 in direct deposits.

steps: Go to https://www.valley.com/personal/banking/checking/journey-checking and open a new All Access Checking account ($100 minimum opening deposit).
Arrange at least $500 in direct deposits to the new account (new customers only).
Keep the account open; the $100 bonus credits per the official offer — the official page states no exact payout timing, so watch the account.
Avoid the $15 monthly fee with $250+ in monthly qualifying direct deposits or a $500+ daily balance.
